extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.

faqs.q: What is the Thorburn CGA96 Industrial Oxygen Service Hose used for?
faqs.a: A Thorburn corrugated stainless steel hose for oxygen service . Typical uses include oxygen supply to cutting and welding stations, liquid and gaseous oxygen transfer and plant oxygen distribution. See the [specialty hose assemblies](/c/metallic-specialty-assemblies).

faqs.q: Thorburn CGA96 Industrial Oxygen Service Hose: what is the typical service life and maintenance schedule?
faqs.a: Service life depends on duty cycle and process exposure. Annual inspection recommended. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: What should I know before ordering the Thorburn CGA96 Industrial Oxygen Service Hose?
faqs.a: Corrugated stainless core and stainless braid, cleaned for oxygen service and capped. Oxygen end connections, so the hose cannot be connected to another gas system. Pressure, temperature and bend radius confirmed per build — oxygen service limits velocity and material choice, so give the full duty. Give the full duty on your request for the Thorburn CGA96 Industrial Oxygen Service Hose.

faqs.q: Thorburn CGA96 Industrial Oxygen Service Hose: what end fittings are used?
faqs.a: CGA-540 oxygen coupler; degreased per CGA G-4.1. End-fitting alloy is typically matched to the inner core for severe service. For cryogenic assemblies, vacuum-jacketed bayonet or threaded couplers are standard; for steam-jacketed assemblies, the inner and outer hoses are sealed at independent flanged ports.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Thorburn CGA96 Industrial Oxygen Service Hose?
faqs.a: To order the Thorburn CGA96 Industrial Oxygen Service Hose, send the fluid, its pressure and temperature, the bore, overall length, both end connections and any standard or certificate the project needs. We confirm the build and its ratings with the maker before quoting, and supply the test certificate with the assembly.

faqs.a: Confirm the host system interface on the RFQ — Indus matches the assembly fittings to your installation. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.a: ISO 10380:2012. PED 2014/68/EU Module H. ASME B31.3, Section VIII Div 1. CGA-8.1-M86, CGA96, CGA G-4.1, UL536. EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports.
